name: Mind Bend — Forest text changed to Island keeps its mana ability
notes: Memory: project_mind_bend_land_type_textchange_2026-05-22. A basic land carries its land type as a subtype (its oracle text is empty), and its mana ability is intrinsic. Replacing Forest with Island must change the subtype to Island and swap the mana ability to {T}: Add {U}. instead of wiping it. The other Forest is the control.
